items: USB-C 100W is a USB-PD Power Source 3 (PS3) high-power output port. If the  connected user device or accessory does not meet safety requirements, there may be a  fire risk. Before using these ports, ensure that the connected device or accessory has fire  safety protection.
Only connect the Jackery HomePower 3600 Plus to devices or accessories that comply  with clauses 6.3, 6.4, and 6.5 of IEC/EN/UL 62368-1 (or other equivalent standards).
To obtain maximum output power, use the official Jackery USB-C to USB-C 5A cable  (20V DC/5A, 100W).
bold_opening: USB-C 100W is a USB-PD Power Source 3 (PS3) high-power output port.
